summary: A 14 m single-section bidirectional city tram (streetcar): a crowned, tumblehome body swept along its length… joints door_lf_a, door_lf_b, door_lr_a, door_lr_b, door_rf_a, door_rf_b, …; options livery, accent, destination; sockets socket_coupler_front, socket_coupler_rear, eye_point, seat_driver, pantograph_contact.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.tram or place "prefab": "tram" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
